comment: The AAD token endpoint refusing a WRONG client secret. AADSTS7000215 never says 'expired', and the outcome must be AUTH_FAILED, not AUTH_EXPIRED (Req 19.6) — the consultant has a value to correct, and rotating a perfectly good secret would not fix it. Recorded alongside aad_expired_secret_rejection.json because the two responses are near-identical in shape and differ only in the code the classifier reads.

body.error_description: AADSTS7000215: Invalid client secret provided.
